args.text: Can you start a short Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call: when the Superior sync broke on 4 Nov, who found the cause, and when it was resolved. Post it here as a draft.

DRAFT – Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call (Dana, please check before it goes anywhere)

Incident: Dock schedule sync at Quarrendon Freight Lines' Superior terminal, 4 Nov 2025 (#inc-qfl-sev1).

- Broke: around 6:40 AM Superior local time, per your report in the channel. Raised as a Sev 1 at 7:02 AM (channel time). Tablets were spinning and drivers were backing up at the guard shack.
- Cause found: Samir Patel (on-call), at 7:17 AM. A deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant. He had started by checking the 06:30 UTC deployment for a bad migration.
- Mitigation: Samir cleared the stuck jobs. Partial sync at about 8:15 AM, with some inbound trailers still duplicating.
- Resolved: Samir's hotfix and replay script finished at 2:38 PM, and all Superior dock schedules were syncing cleanly in real time. You closed the incident at 2:44 PM after Thea confirmed from the yard.

Two things to check: the 6:40 AM start is your estimate in Superior's time and the other times are the channel's display time, so please confirm the zone. The channel doesn't have a postmortem or a root-cause write-up on why the listener deadlocked, so I've left that out.

I posted the draft recap in #north-team. I built it from #inc-qfl-sev1, which you're a member of.

- **Broke:** about 6:40 AM Superior local time, by your own estimate. You raised the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM.
- **Cause found:** Samir Patel, at 7:17 AM. It was a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
- **Resolved:** Samir's hotfix and replay script finished at 2:38 PM, and you closed the incident at 2:44 PM.

Please confirm the time zone before this goes to Thea. The 6:40 AM start is in Superior's time, and I'm not sure the channel timestamps are in the same zone.

The channel has no postmortem, so the draft doesn't say why the listener deadlocked.

Picking up Dana's recap: add that the culprit was a deadlocked webhook listener and that Thea was on the bridge for about twenty minutes, then put 30 minutes on the calendar for Dana and me tomorrow at 10:00 to walk through it.
